note: Adapted from the account of the soldier characters of the genus Mirocapritermes in Ahmad 1958 (Biologia vol. 4, Indomalayan Termites, p. 183); the original is in English. The genus is monotypic, containing only M. connectens; the measurements are taken from Holmgren 1914. The original has only a soldier paragraph, with no descriptions of the alate or the worker, so only a soldier section is given.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellow, covered with fairly dense short hairs, cylindrical, the frons sloping; frontal projection triangular in dorsal view; labrum rectangular, with long anterolateral processes; mandibles asymmetrical; antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 as long as segments 3 and 4 together; head length (with mandibles) 2.01, head length (without mandibles) 1.03, head width 0.68; pronotum width 0.41. (Holmgren, 1914)
